purpose: Repair and rebuild the reusable 2023-only batter PA development panel without reopening any spent selection or confirmation window.

chronology.feature_source_rule: 2023 regular-season source rows with canonical game_date strictly before the 2023 target game_date

source_truth_repairs.terminal_pa: one mapped terminal event on the final pitch of each unique game/batter/at-bat identity
source_truth_repairs.zero_pa: missing raw terminal groups require separately hashed official-final-boxscore zero-PA evidence
source_truth_repairs.denominators: all serialized rates and moments carry count, denominator or missingness lineage

permitted_inputs: historical 2023 target identity and outcome rows
prohibited_inputs: opposing pitcher without receipt-proven pregame identity
